entries.9dad1d3dfe3477ce: Since its founding in 1961, it has developed and manufactured products in the fields of disaster prevention and temperature control, using heat control as its core technology, and has a structure in which it handles design, construction and maintenance itself for fire alarm and fire-extinguishing systems. It runs businesses in both disaster-prevention equipment and temperature-control equipment such as hot plates for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, and it is also registered as a calibration business for temperature sensors.
entries.a41e609e2bda1c97: It has formulated the Medium-Term Management Plan 2025, with key measures of restructuring the business structure through selection and concentration, strengthening the earnings base through new product development, active investment in human capital initiatives and growth foundations, and further strengthening its governance structure. Through a review of its business portfolio, it concentrates management resources on its core disaster-prevention and control equipment, aims to build a closer relationship with Seika Sangyo Co., Ltd., a capital and business alliance partner with an extensive customer base, and states that it intends to expand its sales area centered on the disaster-prevention business.
